edges.reason: Red stained glass is a landmark guiding the player to the nearby black stained glass panes for mining
Purple concrete powder marks the path toward the red nether brick wall section 2 blocks further south
Yellow glazed terracotta is positioned 1 block west of the trapped chest containing crafting materials
Trapped chest contains iron ingot and flint, both required ingredients for crafting flint_and_steel in 2x2 grid
Blue concrete powder marks the location of the librarian villager needed for the paper-to-emerald trade
Green bed is adjacent to the water source pool containing a live salmon for bucket capture

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Red stained glass column is at spawn-relative (13, 0-2, 0), which is 13 blocks from spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must walk at least 8 blocks east to satisfy the check, preventing false positives from simply rotating at spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Purple concrete powder cluster is at spawn-relative (0, 0-1, 13), 13 blocks south of spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must walk at least 8 blocks south to be within range and face the target.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Yellow glazed terracotta column is at spawn-relative (-13, 0-1, 0), 13 blocks west of spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must navigate west at least 8 blocks and face the target.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Green bed foot is at spawn-relative (-10, 0, -10), approximately 14.1 blocks from spawn diagonally (northwest). With max_distance=5, the player must walk at least 9 blocks diagonally to satisfy the distance check.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue concrete powder cluster is at spawn-relative (0, 0-1, -13), 13 blocks north of spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must walk at least 8 blocks north and face the target.

Uses inventory_has because the player has a silk touch diamond pickaxe, which causes black stained glass panes to drop themselves when mined. Panes are at (14,1,0), (14,1,1), (14,1,-1). Player starts with no glass panes in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining with the correct tool.

Uses inventory_has because red nether brick wall drops itself when mined with any pickaxe (silk touch not required but player has it). Wall blocks are at (-1/0/1, 0-1, 15). Player starts with none in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has for iron_ingot because the trapped chest at (-14, 0, 0) contains iron_ingot and flint. Opening the chest triggers its redstone signal. Checking for iron_ingot in inventory is a reliable proxy: the player must open the chest to take items, and downstream tasks require these items, making looting the expected behavior. Player starts with no iron_ingot.

Uses inventory_has for emerald because the librarian villager at (1, 0, -15) has a trade: 24 paper → 1 emerald. Player starts with 24 paper and 0 emeralds. There are no other emerald sources in the scene. Having ≥1 emerald confirms the trade was successfully completed.

Uses inventory_has because using an empty bucket on a live salmon in water produces a salmon_bucket item in the player's inventory. The NoAI salmon is in a 2-block water pool at (-10, 0, -8) near the green bed. Player starts with 1 empty bucket and 0 salmon_buckets. Having ≥1 salmon_bucket confirms successful capture.

Uses inventory_has because crafting flint_and_steel (shapeless 2-ingredient recipe: 1 iron_ingot + 1 flint) in the player's 2x2 inventory grid places the result in inventory. Player starts with no flint_and_steel and obtains ingredients from the trapped chest. Having ≥1 flint_and_steel confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A compact workshop area with colored block landmarks radiating outward from spawn at 13-15 blocks distance. Five distinct zones guide the player to interaction tasks: Zone 1 (East) has red stained glass leading to black stained glass panes; Zone 2 (South) has purple concrete powder leading to red nether brick wall; Zone 3 (West) has yellow glazed terracotta adjacent to a trapped chest with iron ingot and flint; Zone 4 (Northwest) has a green bed next to a water pool with a live salmon for bucket capture; Zone 5 (North) has blue concrete powder marking the librarian villager for paper trading. All landmarks are 13+ blocks from spawn to ensure find milestones with max_distance=5 require genuine navigation.
task_text: Explore the colored landmark workshop. Navigate to find five colored markers scattered around the area: a green bed (northwest), red stained glass (east), yellow glazed terracotta (west), purple concrete powder (south), and blue concrete powder (north). At the red stained glass, mine the nearby black stained glass panes. At the purple concrete powder, mine the red nether brick wall further south. At the yellow glazed terracotta, open the trapped chest to obtain iron ingot and flint, then craft flint and steel in your inventory. At the blue concrete powder, sell 24 paper to the librarian villager. At the green bed, use your bucket on the salmon in the water pool to craft a salmon bucket.
design_notes: Final validated layout: Player spawns at center (0,0,0) on a 36x36 stone brick platform. Five zones radiate outward at 13-15 blocks. Zone 1 (East, +X): Red stained glass column (3-high) at ~13,0-2,0 with 3 black stained glass panes at ~14,1,0/1/-1. Zone 2 (South, +Z): Purple concrete powder cluster at ~0,0-1,13 and ~1,1,13 with 4 red nether brick walls at ~-1/0/1,0-1,15. Zone 3 (West, -X): Yellow glazed terracotta (2-high) at ~-13,0-1,0 with trapped chest at ~-14,0,0 containing iron_ingot and flint. Zone 4 (NW diagonal): Green bed at ~-10,0,-10 (foot) / ~-9,0,-10 (head) with 2-block water pool at ~-10,0,-8 and ~-9,0,-8 containing NoAI salmon. Zone 5 (North, -Z): Blue concrete powder cluster at ~0,0-1,-13 and ~1,1,-13 with lectern at ~1,0,-14 and NoAI librarian at ~1,0,-15. Player inventory: 24 paper, 1 bucket, 1 silk touch diamond pickaxe. Air cleared y=0-2 across entire area. All mechanics validated by team.
